The '''''Imperial''-class 1-H repulsortank''', also known as the '''Imperial Repulsortank 1-H''', was a heavy variant of the [[Imperial-class repulsortank|''Imperial''-class repulsortank]].

==Description==
Constructed by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]], the 1-H was the standard production model of the [[Imperial-class repulsortank|''Imperial''-class repulsortank]]. It mounted a single [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] [[Mark 4e/S heavy laser cannon]], one of the best [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] employed by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], as its main weapon. It had a [[Mark 3/S Medium Blaster Cannon]] as its secondary armament,<ref name="J9" /> as well as two additional blaster cannons mounted on either side of its hull which augmented the already formidable amount of firepower of the tank.<ref name="IHCG" /> The 1-H was crewed by five, including a driver, two [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], and a commanding [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. There was room for single passengers in the tank. Like all ''Imperial''-class repulsortanks, the 1-H was built on the same 20.5 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long chassis and could reach speeds of up to 300 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. It had a cargo capacity of 250 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and a ground clearance of two meters. 1-Hs cost 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="J9" />

==History==
Out of the initial production run of 1,500 [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]], 1,420 were assigned to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], while the rest were given to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. After the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]], during which the majority of the tanks were destroyed, production of the tank continued at a steady, yet reduced pace.<ref name="J9" />

Due to reorganization and retraining of the unit, the Imperial Hammers were not present at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Zel Johans]], the unit's commanding officer, would later maintain that if they had been present, their 1-H tanks would have been more successful against the defending [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces than [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers's]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Imperial_repulsortank_TRAS.jpg|thumb|right|180px]]
An Imperial repulsortank as it was depicted in the [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]] boasts a slightly different design to other depictions of the 1-H, which might result in eventual creation of the [[Imperial Heavy Repulsortank]].
